title: 21 · Conversations and projects: recovered knowledge map
industry_title: Systems knowledge map and practical applications

paras: A topic-oriented index connecting institutional history, computing foundations, Linux, networking, cloud, business and applied GradeSpot implementation. This is not a verbatim or exhaustive export of account conversations.
Technical correction policy: detailed mechanisms, examples and verification in the corrections handbook

Original handwritten sources are preserved in their prior chapters. Recovered conversations below are topic summaries grounded in available context, not word-for-word transcripts. Unverified chronology is marked as a date range rather than a fabricated exact date.

Conceptual bridge: communication and trade → institutions and standards → contracts and delivery → semiconductor hardware → kernel/processes/memory → networks → cloud/distributed systems → governance and operations.
Timeline: 2025 · Foundations · Related Atlas chapters: 01–07
Communication requirements → exchange/trade → standards bodies → institutions, regulation, contracts and enforcement. Distinguish documented chronology from conceptual historical reconstruction.
Provenance: 2025 material reconstructed from accessible Atlas and conversation summaries; exact chat timestamps not independently verified.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Institutional systems · Related Atlas chapters: 07

Public/private/PPP ownership; ministries and departments; policy vs execution; tender, bid, evaluation, award, contract, purchase order, delivery, inspection, invoice and settlement. Enterprise↔AS and department↔VLAN are teaching analogies only.
Provenance: Conversation synthesis; original 2025 transcripts not fully accessible.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Business finance · Related Atlas chapters: 07, 20

CapEx/OpEx, service delivery, recurring revenue, contracts, SLAs, billing, financial controls, cash flow, and risk. Relate business workflow to event-driven state transitions, not literal protocol equivalence.
Provenance: Project discussions and Atlas cross-topic synthesis.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Telecommunications · Related Atlas chapters: 02–06

Spectrum allocation, radio links, wired/wireless transmission, regulation in India and the United States, telecom interconnection and standards. Identify specific statutes only after source verification.
Provenance: Notebook and conversation synthesis.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Silicon · Related Atlas chapters: 08, 15, 18
Fabrication and supply chain; CPU/GPU/NPU/MCU/DSP/ASIC/FPGA; power management, RAM/flash, interfaces, instruction sets, RISC/CISC, x86/ARM. Separate ISA, microarchitecture and device function.
Provenance: Notebook and recovered technical conversation topics.

blocks.h2: 06 · PCIe, NIC, drivers, interrupts and Linux
paras: Timeline: 2025–2026 · Hardware-to-OS · Related Atlas chapters: 08–12
Bus enumeration, PCIe devices, NIC firmware, DMA, interrupts/NAPI, Linux driver, socket buffers, TCP/IP stack and userspace. Follow one packet across physical and software boundaries.
Provenance: Technical notebook and Linux learning discussions.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Memory · Related Atlas chapters: 14, 16–19
Caches, RAM, page frames, page tables, TLB, kernel page allocator, memory zones, NUMA nodes, locality, processes, mmap and page cache; memory pressure and tuning.
Provenance: Handwritten batches and conversation synthesis.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Data lifecycle · Related Atlas chapters: 20
DAS/NAS/SAN; block/file/object; SSD/HDD/tape; SMB/NFS/iSCSI/FC/NVMe-oF/S3; RPO/RTO; backup vs archive; retention, immutability, verification and restoration drills.
Provenance: B018 source and storage discussions.

blocks.h2: 09 · Ethernet, addressing, VLAN, routing and BGP
paras: Timeline: 2025–2026 · Networks · Related Atlas chapters: 08–12
Layering, MAC/IP, ports/sockets, switching, subnetting, VLANs, NAT, firewall, DNS, TLS, BGP/AS, peering, and on-prem/cloud network boundaries.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Runtime · Related Atlas chapters: 14, 20
Processes, threads, context switching, scheduling, foreground/background, batch, RTOS, IPC, sockets, RPC/gRPC, cgroups, namespaces and containers.
Provenance: B018 and prior process discussions.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Distributed computing · Related Atlas chapters: 11–12, 18–19
Hypervisors, VMs, containers, Kubernetes scheduling, control planes, service discovery, load balancing, distributed storage, observability and failure domains.
Provenance: Notebook and deployment conversations.
Timeline: 2025–2026 · Engineering practices · Related Atlas chapters: 12, 19–20
Linux deployment, Terraform state/locking, CI/CD, Kubernetes, IAM, secrets, monitoring, incident/problem/change management, SLIs/SLOs/SLAs, backups, runbooks, handover and recovery.
Provenance: Interview preparation and technical deployment discussions.

blocks.h2: 13 · GradeSpot frontend, Axon backend and multi-repo system
paras: Timeline: 2026 · Applied case study · Related Atlas chapters: 07, 11–12, 19–20

Two independently deployable frontend experiments; one versioned shared modular-monolith API; admin UI; contracts repo; infrastructure repo; public-read caching; Axon-owned writes; lead capture→database→workflow→WhatsApp/email→counsellor; staging vs production; approvals before migration.
Provenance: GradeSpot architecture discussions and local project report.
Timeline: 2026 · Applied security · Related Atlas chapters: 07, 12, 19–20

RBAC, API auth, spam/lead filtering, payments and entitlement verification, webhook signature/replay checks, logs, consent, backups, privacy, accessibility, security headers and least privilege. Verify applicable legal frameworks before publication.
Provenance: GradeSpot project conversations; proposed controls, not audited implementation.
Timeline: 2026 · Applied systems · Related Atlas chapters: 11–12, 19

Managed databases, serverless functions, object storage, CDN/edge, VPS/VM, queue, workflows, monitoring, domain/DNS, backups, quotas and budget alarms. Free tier is not unlimited; revenue/ads are separate from cloud billing.
Provenance: GradeSpot hosting/cost planning.
Timeline: 2026 · Practical Linux lab · Related Atlas chapters: 08–12
Kernel and distro identification, lspci/lsusb, ip link/route, ethtool, dmesg, modinfo, firmware, DHCP, DNS, tcpdump and packet path; distinguish actual measurements from illustrative lab commands.
Provenance: Linux networking troubleshooting discussion.
Timeline: 2026 · Software architecture · Related Atlas chapters: 18–20
Monolithic vs modular monolith vs microservices; contracts/OpenAPI, frontend/backend separation, bounded modules, event processing, operational overhead and distributed failure handling.
Provenance: GradeSpot and architecture discussions.

blocks.h2: 18 · Authorship, source integrity and publication controls
paras: Timeline: 2026 · Knowledge governance · Related Atlas chapters: All

Preserve scans without editing; SHA-256 provenance; original vs interpretation vs corrections; source dates/confidence; unpublished-by-default; explicit owner approval before sharing, GitHub publishing or commercial reuse.
Provenance: User-established Atlas editorial and IP requirements.
